notes.title: Siberian Village 1.0
notes.content:
The release day of my first game has comeːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2067940/Siberian_Village/

Thanks to everyone who supported the game in early access and added the game to their wishlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42652485/3ed007e58c35b9ee6bea30b3d58f329dff471d6f.jpg[/img]

A lot of work has been done in the meantime, both on the content in the game and bug fixes (hopefully I've fixed everything)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42652485/b2b7e608193592d7f56baa6b20e4711703f533d1.jpg[/img]

You can also download a free demo of the game and try out some of the mechanics.

Thanks again everyone!

notes.title: Siberian Village 0.97
notes.content:
List of changes:

1. The mechanics of trading in the kiosk have been changed
2. Updated textures
3. Fixed a lot of bugs
4. Optimization work has been carried out

I have started preparing the game for release, if you find a bug, be sure to write about it, you will help me a lot.

Thank you all for supporting the project!

notes.title: Siberian Village 0.93
notes.content:
A new assignment from a resident!
You can make moonshine and make tinctures from it for Nikita's bar

notes.title: Siberian Village 0.91
notes.content: Minor changes to the game code, bug fixes, reworking of some mechanics and optimization

notes.title: Siberian Village 0.9
notes.content:
List of changes:

1. The mechanics of furniture assembly have been redesigned
2. Work has been done on optimization
3. Added cooking mechanics
4. Some bugs have been fixed

Very soon, the release of version 1.0
, I will work on correcting all the errors that I find, as well as add new content.

Thank you all for supporting the project!

notes.title: Siberian Village 0.8
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug in furniture assembly training
2. Added mail delivery mechanics
3. New tasks from residents
4. Fixed a bug in the minimap
5. The mechanics of oil sales have been redesigned
6. Added the mechanics of selling a tree
7. The mechanics of sawing trees have been changed, now all trees are being sawn at once.
8. Changed the mechanics of opening doors, now they open with the [E] key
And many other fixes

Thank you so much for supporting my project, I will continue to try to improve the game!

notes.title: Siberian Village 0.73
notes.content:
1. Reworked fishing mechanics
2. Added camera animation when boarding cars
3. Fixed an error when opening the card
4. Fixed a bug in the management settings
5. Fixed a bug with the drawing distance

In the next update I will add more quests from residents
Thank you all for supporting the project!

notes.title: Siberian Village 0.71
notes.content:
Version 0.71

Fixed mechanics of tasks from residents
Fixed the mini map
Fixed a bug with boarding the car
Fixed a bug with falling trees

notes.title: Siberian Village 0.7
notes.content:
Version 0.7

The tree felling system has been redesigned
Added a map of the area
Updated character design
Added tasks from residents
2 mechanics have been added: welding and snow removal, they will become available to you while receiving tasks from residents

There is still a lot of work to do, thank you for supporting the project!)

notes.title: Version 0.6
notes.content:
I'm still working on "Siberian Village"

In 0.6 I continued to work on bug fixes and game improvements

At night the village is finally visible)

A new car is available to you - VAZ 2101
The restoration of houses in the game is also available

In version 0.7, I will also work on improving the game and continuing the quest.

Thank you all for supporting the project!

notes.title: Version 0.55
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42652485/0f7dd46165fc21e6a1807aaa64c95d28c9c68bf7.png[/img]

A small update of the game.

With each update, the game will get better and better.

I started working on optimizing the game, you can see the first result in the game, I will continue to work on it.

In the next update, I will work on fixing bugs and add new content.

The game is in early access and you can take part in its creation, write what you would like to see in the game.

Mechanics, characters, events, or anything else, I'm always glad for your feedback.

Thank you for supporting my project!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Siberian Village Версия 0.5
notes.content:
Management of a sawmill in Siberian Village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42652485/cda551cf2f9aed4989184e8e5d3b60b95042e1be.png[/img]

The mechanics of processing logs into boards and making furniture are available.
In future updates, the mechanics will get better and better.

Write, how do you like the new mechanics in the game? I will be glad to receive feedback!

notes.title: Business in Siberia
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42652485/ed52bfeedd40af66eb6914cea391fbe5fe594149.jpg[/img]
Open your own business in a Siberian village.
In version 0.47

- 3 villages, private sector and suburb
- A plot to familiarize yourself with the mechanics
- Oil well management
- Stall management
- Refueling and riding a VAZ 2106
- Logging on a sawmill
- Home improvement
- Interactive light in the village
- Change of day and night, if you don't want to wait, that is, the mechanics of sleep

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42652485/20024c5b6a9df8da8fd5afdc1679d99aaf29bbac.jpg[/img]

In future updates there will be new mechanics (sawmill management, winter greenhouses and much more), there will also be a revision of the current mechanics.

Write to what you would like to see in Siberian Village

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42652485/3e33da6ed83670a98db61ed3bccea419e33f6cf0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Siberian Village version 0.1
notes.content: I really want to get feedback from you. What can be added to the game, what bugs are present, as well as suggestions for new story chapters and possible game modes. Be sure to write about everything that comes to mind, even "balalaika" write, I will listen to everyone!)
